accepted_scope: Use exact terminal-amount comparison in native live scoring and resumed log scoring; resumed scoring reparses the saved raw response rather than inheriting old GPT Predicted errors.
remaining_limits: Constructed-response and amount-echo validation only; no observed model-performance effect.
Requires the native terminal phrase, US numeric format, at most two decimal places, optional USD and terminal period. Other prose/symbol formats are rejected.
Does not repair rule-attribution scoring, policy ambiguity or reference amounts.

The first marker must begin the terminal amount statement. Colon variants, space after $, closing quotes/parentheses, earlier non-answer markers and post-answer prose are rejected even when the numeric answer is correct; these are interface failures, not policy-reasoning failures.
